automationCard.contract: The card fieldset disables configuration when offline/configDisabled; Trade passes configDisabled from online state.

sharedUi.contract: Shared failed-save UI retries flush() and discards through refresh(true).

contracts.currency: Unchecking the last selected currency is rejected. Currency edits flush immediately. Trade passes saving=false to the source currency selector.
contracts.goods: Goods selection is unique and ascending by item id. Unselecting the final good forces enabled=false. Exclusive-only goods are disabled. Trade passes saving=false to the source goods selector.
contracts.exclusive: Show exclusive is local view state. Hidden by default; enabling it reveals exclusive-only goods without making them selectable.
contracts.restrictions: Trade selection is disabled offline by the enclosing card. No Trade task-busy selection restriction was recovered. Source explicitly suppresses saving as a selector restriction.
contracts.saveFailure: Selection edits retain the dirty draft after failure. Retry flushes it; Discard refreshes the confirmed/server value.
